presentationOnlyExclusions.reason: Light/dark styling has no simulation effect.
Selecting a displayed chart series does not mutate simulation state; all series remain queryable.
Loan/account sorting and filters only change the visible table selection.
Browser tab visibility has no remote client equivalent; explicit pause remains supported.

knownUnresolved: The engine-free evaluation client/provider adapter, joined client transcript collection, replay/batch CLI and operator/container workflow are not implemented yet.
The current Pages GUI bundles src/config/scenarios.ts. Treat the current scenario catalogue as public; no server-only private-scenario loader is implemented.
Loan report sorting and cohort filter state are presentation interactions; the API returns the full report categories and supports portfolio selection, not separate sort/filter parameters.
The API Past games report is scoped to the assigned run and returns its decision timeline and summary snapshots. The browser may also list other attempts saved in that browser profile.
Live VPS installation, HTTPS reverse-proxy configuration, backup/restore and production hardening have not been performed.
Registry parity tests detect missing registered reports/controls, but cannot automatically discover future unregistered UI screens; new player surfaces require a parity review.
